item.title: Standout freshmen propel Notre Dame women's lacrosse to victory over Pittsburgh
item.description: On a breezy Saturday here in South Bend, Ind., the No. 8 Notre Dame women's lacrosse team took on the Pittsburgh Panthers. The Irish, who earned the lacrosse world's attention after defeating perennial powerhouse Boston College, were seeking to bounce back from their loss against Virginia Sunday. item.title: Saint Mary's softball splits 2-2 at Earlham Invitational
item.description: Kicking off its season, the Saint Mary's softball team made its way to Earlham College in Richmond, Indiana. There, it competed in a two-day tournament, playing four games. item.title: Does Notre Dame deserve an 'F' for free expression?
item.description: It's the collective nightmare of all Notre Dame students: a failing grade.But that's exactly what our University received last semester on its "free speech report card." According to the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression (FIRE), Notre Dame ranks in the bottom 20% of universities nationwide when it comes to issues of free speech and free expression. item.title: Ostermann's withdrawal shouldn't have happened
item.description: On Feb. 26, Susan Ostermann, who had been appointed to serve as director of the Liu Institute for Asia and Asian Studies, withdrew from the role. Following the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision, Ostermann had publicly expressed views supporting legal protections for access to abortion. item.description: Once every week, Notre Dame students go to prison. item.title: SMC and ND communities react to death of Iranian supreme leader
item.description: Beginning Feb. 28, the U.S. military operation known as "Epic Fury" brought a series of large-scale military strikes across Iran, killing the supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, among others.
